description: This is a PHP source file defining a REST API endpoint for managing User entities within an admin context of the OrangeHRM system. It provides CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete) for User objects, including validation rules, request handling, and interaction with service and model layers.

classes.name: UserAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing User entities in the OrangeHRM system, providing CRUD operations and validation for admin users.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single user by ID, returning a UserModel if found.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all users based on query filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new User with data provided in the request body.

methods.name: setUserParams
methods.description: Populates a User entity's fields from request parameters, optionally including the password.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing user identified by ID, with optional password change.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getOne' operation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' operation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new user.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Constructs common validation rules related to user creation or update.

methods.name: getUserCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Returns an option object for enforcing entity uniqueness with specific ignore parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a user entity and saves changes, optionally updating the password.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a user.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple users based on provided IDs, excluding undeletable ones.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete operation, ensuring IDs are valid and permissible.
